messages:
Ben: Heads up — 101 bridge is sleet-y right now, scooter lanes basically ice rinks :cold_sweat: bumped into a puddle, shoes soaked. Bus crawling. Leaving from SoMa, might be ~20m late.
Priya: Ugh same. Ferry looked fine this morning but buses are a mess. Bringing dry socks to office? :socks: 
Kai: Anyone know if the 10X is rerouting? Saw a detour sign near 4th & King.
TransitBot: Muni alert: "Surface delays on 9, 10X, and 14 due to hazardous conditions; expect 10-25 minute delays." https://sfmta.org/alerts/10X
Olivia: Thanks @TransitBot — lol the 10X driver just waved everyone off at Townsend and walked the bus around a flooded bit :laughing:
Ben: Can someone pick up a pair of spare shoes at the office? Mine are toast.
Sam: I can grab them. Which floor should I leave them on? I'll toss them on the mail table by 2pm.
Priya: Also PSA — if you're on scooters, slow down. Saw two near-misses by Civic Center, slippery tiles + puddles = sketchy. :eyes: 
Kai: If anyone's switching to remote today because of the weather, ping me and I can flip the standup link to Zoom.
Ben: Good call Kai — I'm remote until the roads clear. See y'all on Zoom in 20.
Olivia: Stay safe everyone! :umbrella:
